hero.name: Oswell Kudzai Mapuranga
hero.description: Designer who codes and AI enthusiast. I craft user-friendly designs and responsive front-end solutions, blending creativity with functionality, while actively implementing AI to enhance workflows and design outcomes.

carouselImages.description: Website Redesign – Using insights from the previous site, I refined the UX before crafting the final UI design. Since launch, the new design has received highly positive feedback from users.

CX Mappers Mobile App – Designed the mobile UI for a gig-based platform that helps users earn extra income through task completion. Collaborated with another designer to craft an intuitive interface and brought the experience to life through an interactive prototype.

Self-Awareness App – Designed the mobile UI screens as part of an assessment challenge, following provided guidelines to create a clean, reflective experience focused on self-awareness and personal growth.

Recovery City – Designed the UI for a platform connecting users to towing and transport services. Although development didn’t proceed, I completed the full interface design in Figma, capturing the platform’s vision through a clean and functional layout.
Website UX Audit & Redesign – Conducted a UX audit of the existing site and, through research and gathered insights, transformed the findings into a fresh, user-centered UI design.
Onboarding UI Screens – A set of onboarding concepts designed for my Dribbble page, showcasing smooth user flow, clean visuals, and engaging first-time user experiences.

MSC Website Redesign – I crafted the end-to-end experience for the MSC website, turning research insights and competitive analysis into an intuitive, visually engaging interface. From mapping the user journey to testing prototypes with real users, every step focused on creating a seamless digital experience.
Web3 Mobile UI – Designed the mobile interface for a Web3 platform, marking my first exploration into using gradients to create a modern and dynamic visual style.

UIF Contribution Calculator – Created as part of an interview assessment, this project showcased my ability to design clear, functional layouts. It was also my first project implemented with the help of AI, and the design received great feedback despite not landing the role.
Flight Booking App – Designed the mobile UX/UI for a locally focused flight booking app, creating a seamless and intuitive experience for users to search, book, and manage flights effortlessly.

Custom Forms Builder – The company needed a better way to collect information from clients, so I proposed and designed a forms builder concept. The prototype effectively solved their challenge and was adopted as the final design.

sections.title: Design
sections.description: I design intuitive, user-friendly interfaces that balance aesthetics and functionality. With expertise in UX/UI, I focus on clean visuals, responsive layouts, and seamless experiences for web and mobile. My approach is user-centered, ensuring each design is impactful and effective.

sections.title: Code
sections.description: I’m skilled in front-end development, turning design concepts into responsive, interactive web experiences. With expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and React, I create clean, scalable code that ensures seamless user interactions and smooth performance across all devices.

aboutMe.title: About Me
description: Hi, I’m Oswell Kudzai Mapuranga, a product designer with a unique blend of creativity and technical know-how. I’m passionate about creating user-centered designs that not only look great but also work seamlessly. My journey into design started with a love for technology and an insatiable curiosity for understanding how things work—and how to make them better.

I thrive at the intersection of design and development, bridging the gap between conceptual ideas and functional code. Whether it’s designing intuitive interfaces, optimizing user experiences, or coding the finer details, I love turning complex problems into simple, elegant solutions.

When I’m not designing, you’ll probably find me geeking out over the latest gadgets, diving into anything nerdy, or enjoying a good game—both on and off the field. I’m also a lifelong learner, always exploring new tools, trends, and technologies to expand my skill set and stay ahead in the ever-evolving tech space.
